environment.execution: sequential benchmarks; shared host scheduling/frequency uncontrolled

methodology.artifacts: deterministic canonical inputs/results regenerated from exact code/workload; generated files ignored, durable hashes retained
methodology.limitations: no production/ultra-low-latency claim; copy control is not semantically equivalent to full event; no optimization inferred from noisy samples
methodology.memory: native_vm_hwm_bytes is post-exec /proc/self/status high-water; wait-accounted child RSS may retain inherited worker floor; both include native fixture/oracle/export/driver/proc-read, not engine-only RAM; PMR separately scoped
methodology.service_times: separate serial wrapper pass, clock/checksum/lifecycle overhead; no external arrival queue; simulated scheduler still runs
methodology.throughput: median bulk-wrapper operations/s; setup/export outside interval
